description: This file defines a Bootstrap tab component plugin, including the Tab class, its methods, and jQuery plugin registration. It manages tab activation, transitions, and event handling.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Class representing tab behavior, including show and activate methods.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the selected tab, handling activation and transition effects.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Handles the activation of a tab or tab content, including transition effects.
